`offcanvas` slides the sidebar out of view, `icon` shrinks it to its icons and shows each label in a tooltip, and `none` keeps it open. Press `⌘B` or `Ctrl+B` to toggle the sidebar you are working in.
`variant` sets the look: a full-height `sidebar`, a `floating` panel, or `inset`, where the page becomes a card on the sidebar color. Switch between them to see the layout animate.
